qualifications: Neither full-GHC benchmark produced a qualified repetition; no n=3 result, completed-index timing median, or performance comparison follows from these diagnostics.

The intermediate candidate reached its 1800-second process cap. Its persisted indexing marker and pending references remain evidence of incomplete resolution even though three later ToolHandler queries expose the requested paths.

The baseline has a persisted complete marker but its benchmark failed with two parser timeouts. File accounting includes records for errored files and is not proof that every file was extracted successfully.

Both snapshots contain 44 warning diagnostics and two error diagnostics. Both pass bounded full integrity_check and foreign_key_check; storage integrity does not establish semantic completeness or precision.
Postmeasurement ToolHandler timings are single snapshot diagnostics, separate from the timed indexing campaign and excluded from its performance statistics.
Two candidate exploration outputs are truncated, but their extracted Flow sections and stored responses are not. These distinct flags are preserved per query.
Database/WAL preservation is derived only from before/after metadata already recorded by the completed scripts; this summary performs no new filesystem fingerprinting or process inspection.
The supported-file scope includes non-Haskell files. The 14891 stored file records comprise 14011 Haskell files and the separately reported other-language counts.
